newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end strong, set to push higher.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end strong, set to push higher.

text.p: 1815 GMT - Portuguese shares closed stronger, with the PSI20 index hitting an historic high. Dealers said the market would keep pushing up until the end of the year but they said much of the buying was the result of investors switching shares from one portfolio to another.
*PSI20 index .PSI20 closed up 25.93 at 5,103.52. It earlier reached an historic high of 5,104.14.
*Portugal Telecom added 39 esc to finish at 4,368 on volume of 845,094.
*Cimpor was also up 39 esc at 3,329 with 376,766 shares traded.
*BPI-SGPS edged up 5 esc to 1,990 on turnover of 188,109.
*BESCL was 10 higher at 2,720 on trade of 175,763.
